decision: Help a reviewer find and understand the most relevant evidence with minimal friction.
primary_outcome: Successful completion of a predefined evidence-finding task and correct interpretation of its main limitation.
denominator: All consenting assigned review tasks, including noncompletion; page views and return visits are separate proxies.
independence_unit: Reviewer; repeated tasks from one reviewer are dependent.
quality_guardrail: Broken links, misleading outcome claims, accessibility barriers and privacy.
minimum_data: Consented anonymous task assignment, completion/timeout, comprehension response, timing and page/version; no resume or contact data in analytics.
failure_handling: Keep timeouts and noncompletion. Missing comprehension answers remain unknown; optional local events do not measure production engagement.
release_rule: Local checks can establish link/calculation correctness. Claim improved reviewer comprehension only after a valid task comparison; synthetic returns cannot support recruiter-interest claims.
reversal: Role navigation increases confusion, hides evidence limitations, or requires unnecessary tracking.
status: PROPOSED MEASUREMENT CONTRACT; NOT AN EXECUTED DOMAIN EXPERIMENT
defense: Is the website itself proof of analytical impact?
It demonstrates communication and implementation. The substantive evidence is in the linked projects, and the site has no measured hiring conversion effect.
Tracking adds privacy and implementation costs. First define a decision that needs the data and use consented minimal task measurements.
